research_result.description: Apify is a platform for web scraping, data extraction, and browser automation that provides serverless cloud programs called Actors, structured storage systems, and integration interfaces for AI agents.
research_result.credential_requirements: Developers can register for a free account on Apify Console with no credit card required to obtain an API token under Settings > API & Integrations, or authorize via OAuth 2.0.

evidence.claim: Apify offers a REST API that controls all platform operations.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: All aspects of the Apify platform can be controlled via a REST API, which is described in detail in the API Reference.

evidence.claim: Apify supports OAuth 2.0 and API token for API authentication.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Apify supports two main authentication methods for secure API access.

evidence.claim: Apify provides self-serve free plan access requiring no credit card.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: The free plan includes monthly platform usage credits with no credit card required.

evidence.claim: Apify provides a dedicated hosted MCP server for AI agents.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: The Apify's MCP server (mcp.apify.com) allows AI applications and agents to interact with the Apify platform using Model Context Protocol (MCP).
